additional_info.subject: Connector 2 Not Charging – DC Meter Fault ( SN: 312900727012)
additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens Support,
We have a fault at station , S/N 312900727012 (Delek – Hashuk Hasitonai).
Connector 2 is not working. The following errors appear:
•     006: Failure to read power meter
•     LEM DC Meter error – ID 1223150053
•     EVSE is not ready
The DC meter (LEM DCBM N00 4000 0000) displays FATAL ERROR, code 512, register FF#.
We restarted the unit, checked power (24VDC) and wiring – all OK.
Please advise the next steps for diagnosis and whether replacement is needed
Thanks.
Ahmed Haim
Electrician

additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support,
As requested, I performed a test on Connector 2 at station , S/N 312900727012, on Thursday, May 22, 2025, at 09:20 (Israel time).
Issue details:
•     The vehicle successfully initiates communication with the charger.
•     Within 1 second, the session stops with no energy delivered (0 kWh).
•     Immediately after that, Connector 2 changes status to OUT OF ORDER on the screen.
•     The screen displays “Charging Completed” although no actual charging took place.
Please find attached photos showing:
•     The start of the charging process
•     Session summary showing 0 kWh delivered
•     Connector 2 status as “OUT OF ORDER” at 09:20
Kindly advise on the next steps to resolve this issue.
Thank you,

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0425927-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2/R2 312900727012] Connector 2 Not Working CRM:02889000011
additional_info.body:
Hello Ahmed Haim,
Thank you for your detailed report and the accompanying photos regarding the issue observed with Connector 2 at station.
We identified that the session was interrupted due to a LEM-related error, which consequently caused the outlet to be marked as "Out of Order" and resulted in no energy being delivered.
We have since addressed the issue. A follow-up review of the most recent logs confirms that the error is no longer present, and Connector 2 is now operating normally.
As a precaution, we will continue to monitor the charger over the next 24 hours. Should the issue persist, we will escalate the matter to our regional team for on-site intervention.
Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you observe any further anomalies or need additional support.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
